pass: MAHPLAZA v5 — ULTRA CHROMIUM CITY closure
note: Statuses are judged from the actual-runtime captures in this folder at 1280x720 and at phone size, not from intent. BASELINE frames are the v4 crystalline-night pass in ../mahplaza-v4/.

gates.name: Chromium / dark platinum reads as a MAJOR world material, with finish grades
gates.note: materials.js carries five grades ranked by how much of the world may wear each: chromeMirror 0.03 (focal trim, hero catches, floor joints), chromeSatin 0.17 (structural framing, lamp columns, rails), platinumBrushed 0.34 (large secondary surfaces, crowns, canopies, street furniture), graphiteMetal 0.52 (mass), crystalGlass 0.06 (windows). A finish is a roughness, not a hue, so the world stays one civilization.

gates.name: The plaza floor is a HERO surface with architectural-scale diamond geometry
gates.note: Nine-metre chromium diamond cells, each a chamfered slab with a sub-half-degree deterministic tilt, in mirror-grade joint catches inside the 28 m hero field and satin catches out to 43 m. The floor is a deck: dressing, residents, ambient life and planters all stand on it.

gates.name: Rounded architecture — no un-bevelled 90° corners, no Minecraft/Roblox box feel
gates.note: Every box in buildings.js is chamfered with a chamfer that scales with the part, down to a 0.06 m bar. The gym's canopy is a swept curve built from 22 segment planes, not a folded plate.

gates.name: MAH GYM / MATCH / MARKET separated in depth with distinct silhouettes
gates.note: One exported SITE PLAN at three depths and three scales — gym nearest and broad, market midground and terraced, match furthest and dominant — which the ground aprons, plaza routes and life network all read rather than restate. Silhouette treatments: broadCanopy(), terraces(), verticalTower().

gates.name: Megatall skyline with varied crowns and height parallax
gates.note: Twelve megatalls at 214–392 m in three new archetypes (stepped shaft + spire, notched twin blade, crystalline pinnacle) on overlapping radii 380–665 m, so they occlude each other and the 27 v4 towers in front of them. Fog's far plane moved out to 880 m at night so they are not eaten by the bank.

gates.name: Many more FOBEAMs, each thinner and smaller, moving asynchronously in tiers
gates.note: Forty routes instead of five. Near / mid / far tiers each carry their own gauge, tessellation and brightness; the far tier is generated along a band arcing across the sky, denser toward its middle, a third of it running nearly straight. No two packets share a speed even on one route.

gates.name: Diamond clouds more visible; midtones brighter; premium lamps and street furniture
gates.note: Cloud bodies sit a value higher across 20 masses instead of 14, with stronger crystalline catches. Every neutral moved up a step out of near-black. Lamps are tapered satin columns on mirror foot rings with machined collars, brackets, mirror shades and square-diamond luminaires; the plaza gained wayfinding blades, planted plinths, a second shelter and utility columns.

gates.name: The ULTRA DVD / PS5 test — a still frame reads as a premium real-time world
gates.note: Judged from the no-labels set at phone size.

gates.name: Character crystallization and detail tiers
gates.note: Closes the v4 discrepancy: residents.js now implements the lod tiers, createImpostor() and setLOD() its header claimed. The species is identical at every tier — square-diamond head with its dark facial chamber, humanoid upper body, one continuous teardrop, no legs — only the triangle count expressing it changes. life.js uses the module's own impostor and tiers.

gates.name: Performance discipline
gates.note: Draw calls and triangles per view are in capture.json. Everything is merged per material or instanced; effects are pooled with a hard cap of six; quality tiers move cost without losing composition. Frame times here come from software GL and are NOT phone numbers.

discrepancies: The reserved square-diamond mark slot on the three signs is still empty: no verified FOB or MAHFITT mark file has been supplied.
Cloud shadows are not cast; clouds contribute light through their own catches and the sky keys only.

Frame times in every capture come from headless software GL on a shared 4-core machine and are inflated; only draw calls, triangles, lights and shadow-caster counts are device-independent. No real-device measurement exists in this environment.
